snippet.title: The Snake Is the Tower Trailer
snippet.description:
A short snake tower defense hybrid where every segment you grow is a new tower. Grow the perfect living weapon. Claim territory, fortify your domain, and evolve through endless cosmic hordes.

Wishlist and play the demo today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957070/The_Snake_Is_the_Tower/
Join the discord: https://discord.gg/H3JWUBQX
